name: social_graph_persistence
summary: SQLite-backed directed multigraph of Facebook-derived player relationships plus an append-only JSONL audit trail. Nodes are players (FB-derived identity, optional lat/lon/country); edges are friendships tagged by source_via (graph_api | fb_instant | manual). Multi-edge by design — (A->B via graph_api) and (A->B via fb_instant) are distinct provenance facts and coexist on PRIMARY KEY (source_player, target_player, source_via). Symmetric friendships default to bidirectional writes. Every upsert appends one audit row and anchors a crystal_id via inference_logger (try/except — never blocks). Stdlib-only — sqlite3 / json / math / hashlib. Public API: upsert_player, upsert_edge, get_player, get_friends, get_friend_of_friend, find_in_radius (haversine + country-centroid fallback), stats, export_for_planet_map.
engine_pattern: Module-level functions that open a fresh sqlite3 connection per call (cheap on local FS), execute the operation, close, then audit. No global ORM, no connection pool. Schema auto-applied on every _connect() via CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS — idempotent. CLI subcommands: stats, upsert-player, upsert-edge, friends, fof, radius, player, export-planet.

players.name: TEXT
players.first_seen: INTEGER — unix epoch of first upsert
players.last_seen: INTEGER — unix epoch of latest upsert
players.crystal_id: TEXT — crystal hash anchoring the latest upsert

friend_edges.crystal_id: TEXT — crystal hash for this upsert

storage.db_path: ~/.cc/social_graph.sqlite (mode 600 on first create; override via MSPC_SOCIAL_GRAPH_DB)
storage.audit_path: ~/.cc/social_graph_audit.jsonl (mode 600 on first create; shadows DB path when override is set)

substrate: sqlite3 file at MSPC_SOCIAL_GRAPH_DB or ~/.cc/social_graph.sqlite; audit JSONL alongside; inference_logger master chain receives one crystal anchor per upsert (best-effort).

inbound_callers: core/lib/facebook_friends_graph.py (parallel agent — calls upsert_player / upsert_edge as the Graph API + fb_instant capture pipeline ingests friend lists)
studio/dapp /api/social_graph HTTP endpoint (get_player, get_friends, export_for_planet_map for client reads)
godot planet_map_scene (fetches export_for_planet_map JSON for the orbital friend visualization)
outbound_calls: core/lib/inference_logger.InferenceLogger().log(tier='social_graph', model='social_graph', scope='upsert_{op}', ...) — best-effort crystal anchor per upsert; failures swallowed so the social graph never blocks on inference-chain availability
routing_connections.substrate_writes: sqlite DB + JSONL audit + crystal-chain (via inference_logger)

haversine: Pure stdlib (math.radians/sin/cos/atan2). Earth radius 6371.0088 km. Distance computed against player.lat/lon when present; falls back to COUNTRY_CENTROIDS dict for ~85 ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes covering the largest populations.
country_centroid_fallback: When a player has country_code but no explicit lat/lon, find_in_radius and export_for_planet_map drop to COUNTRY_CENTROIDS[code] for an approximate position. Documented as approximate (population-weighted geographic centroid). Result rows carry centroid_fallback=true so consumers know.
guarantees: Schema is auto-created on first use — no migration step required
DB and audit file are mode 600 on first create
Crystal anchor is best-effort — inference_logger failure never blocks an upsert
Audit log is append-only — JSONL; no row is ever rewritten or deleted
Multi-edge on PRIMARY KEY (source, target, source_via) so graph_api and fb_instant evidence coexist
self-loop edges are rejected at upsert_edge
bidirectional=True is the default — friendships are symmetric facts
Stdlib-only — no external Python deps required (no networkx, no geopy)
cli_examples: python3 core/lib/social_graph_persistence.py upsert-edge tom_dev alice --via fb_instant
phase: social_graph foundation — paired with facebook_friends_graph capture agent and consumed by dApp + Godot planet map
